name: Eopneumatosuchus
sum: Eopneumatosuchus is a basal crocodyliform from two localities of the Early Jurassic Kayenta Formation of Arizona.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Fossils from two nearby localities in the Kayenta Formation, about 20 miles southeast of the Grand Canyon.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Crompton and Smith 1980
